acceptance.criterion: mine_run_directory scans demo/runs/*/ artifacts (program.think parsed with tolerance, evaluation.json missing/invalid tolerated, WORKLOG.md optional, optional *.db event stores)
acceptance.evidence: src/tikhon/learn.py mine_run_directory; tests/test_learn.py::test_parse_error_and_invalid_evaluation_tolerated (broken program + invalid JSON -> parse_error_runs + unknown status), test_event_store_failed_payloads_mined (real EventStore FAILED payload -> other cluster), test_telemetry_counts (run without evaluation.json -> unknown).

acceptance.criterion: Protocol candidates: recurring maximal step-command subsequences with support >= 2 distinct programs, carrying command sequence, support, example run ids, snake_case suggested name from first three commands

acceptance.criterion: Failure clusters bucketed (identifier syntax, reference arrays, missing commands, path errors, other) with counts and 200-char-truncated representative quotes

protocol_deviations: The installed tikhon CLI binary resolves to /home/alexkay28/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages (stale, non-editable) while pytest uses the repo src via pyproject pythonpath; lint/seal were run with the installed CLI as mandated and the digest was cross-verified byte-identical with the repo parser, but CLI learn evidence was produced with PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tikhon. No repo file was changed to work around this.

A concurrent agent modified src/tikhon/syntax/parser.py, src/tikhon/syntax/model.py and src/tikhon/runtime/coordinator.py in the same working tree during this run (issue-07 wave); those changes are outside this run's allowed file set, were not touched by this run, and the seal was re-verified stable across them. The mined corpus grew from 13 to 15 runs mid-task, exercising the miner's tolerance for a run dir (issue-07-revise-retire) whose evaluation.json was not yet complete.

The maximal-candidate rule keeps short 2-command sequences such as 'define -> search' (support 14) when no longer candidate covers all their programs; this is the formal maximal-repeat definition from the issue and keeps the report deterministic, but reviewers may prefer a longer minimum sequence length when promoting candidates to protocols/.
